engines.aggregate: financial_analysis/dcf.py StochasticDCF — independent normal draws (growth/margin/WACC/tg), one per path; scenarios.py presets seed 7; IBM registry entries are v3-era
engines.driver: financial_analysis/driver_dcf.py DriverDCF — only drivers stochastic, correlated joint draw (Cholesky) held constant per path (parameter-MC, no AR(1): T-DCF-1); per-path CAPM WACC with kd derived from rf; flat term structure; tg guard min(tg, wacc-2%) with pinned fraction reported; clip-after-correlation truncation; percentiles only, no mean/std; driver_draws exposed per path

dcf_implementation_superseded_note: Earlier versions of this file described only Tickets 1-6 and the aggregate DCF; that content is superseded by the above and by docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. The Tickets 1-6 history is preserved in PLANNING/tickets.md.
fcf_sign_note: capex is stored sign-flipped (negative) by the importer; schema.free_cash_flow uses OCF - abs(capex). Fixed 2026-06-12 (was overstating FCF by 2x capex).
smoke_test_policy: Every ticket requires a live smoke test before closing. A ticket is not done until real output is printed and confirmed consumable by the next ticket.
orchestration_norms: Subagents do not commit (orchestrator does); parallel file work uses git worktrees; review .docx via a COPY (officecli mutates on open); memo-review PostToolUse hook fires on any produced .docx; fixed seeds (7); persist resume-state in files (PLANNING/HANDOFF.md pattern); never commit the tracked-but-gitignored xlsx/.pyc warts.
notes: Agents should be concise when updating README.md and context.json.
